grounded_result: GSE108497 robust host-module-like SLE signal; GSE10325 sorted subset inconclusive
hypothesis: EBV module robustness and multiple-testing accounting
interpretation: Multiple-testing and permutation checks support a SLE-associated host EBV-module-like blood signal in GSE108497 after IFN/APC residualization. Sorted-cell GSE10325 remains inconclusive for B-cell/APC localization. Neither dataset has EBV exposure/load metadata, so EBV imprint causality remains unproven.
